part.text:
Fixed. Changes:

- `caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/options.go`: `default_bind` now uses a new `parseOptDefaultBind` parser that accepts multiple addresses on one line and accumulates addresses across multiple `default_bind` lines (options.go:270).
- `caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/addresses.go`: default bind lookup now expects `[]string` and appends each address (deduplicated) instead of a single string (addresses.go:360).

Verified: `go build ./...`, `go test ./caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/...`, and `go test ./caddytest/...` all pass, and adapting the issue's Caddyfile now produces all three listen addresses (`[2001:db8:11:ad::80]:33441`, `198.51.100.184:33441`, `tcp6/[2001:db8::1]:33441`).
